objects.name: Detection technique coverage: o365-multiple-appids-and-useragents-authentication-spike
objects.description: The following analytic identifies unusual authentication activity in an O365 environment, where a single user account experiences more than 8 authentication attempts using 3 or more unique application IDs and over 5 unique user agents within a short timeframe. It leverages O365 audit logs, focusing on authentication events and applying statistical thresholds.
